correctness.rationale: For the four-state symmetric switching generator, stationary separation exists by negative ergodic mean log multiplier K>0. Its second moment is finite iff the Perron spectral bound of Q-2diag(K+phi) is negative, equivalent by a three-dimensional Schur complement to B>0. Stationary conditional Itô moment equations yield w=DN/(2B); the killed-chain eigenfunction [Q-diag(K+phi)]psi=-(K+2lambda)psi gives the exact Green--Kubo finite-time increment formula. Differentiation yields derivative sign proportional to K(K+lambda)-a^2; B endpoint signs give all critical cases and the exact divergence residue. On the other side, positive Perron projections and conditioning on a future no-jump event imply infinite second moments of any stationary center increment. The closed classes at chi=1 are addressed separately. Exact standard-library checks: 828 four-state rational configurations and 27 compensation identities. Infinite claims rest on proof, not finite checks.
